title: Brand Response Authorization Result
description: Verifier-local result of the additive 3.2 brand.json authorization cross-check for a cryptographically valid verify_brand_claim or verify_brand_claims signed response. This object is produced by the verifier and is not a field asserted by the responding brand agent.

trust.description: Whether the signing key was bound to the asserted brand_domain through an authorized brand-agent entry. An untrusted result MUST NOT extend or revoke relationship trust on its own.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for an untrusted result.

kid.description: JWS kid evaluated by the cross-check.

jwks_uri.description: JWKS URI selected only from the matched brand.json agent entry, or its same-origin default.
